title: Performance - Stats Tab
prompt:
iPhone screen 393x852 for a personal NY Real Estate Salesperson exam prep PWA. Dark OLED canvas #090d16, surfaces #111725 and #182033, ink #f1f5f9, secondary ink #a3b1c6. Design language "Wayfinding": New York transit signage. Headings in Helvetica Neue bold, tight tracking, sentence case. Every syllabus topic is a route bullet: a 26px colored circle with a bold 1-character code, always next to the topic name. Route colors are topic identity only (red #DA291C codes 1 2 3, green #00843D codes 4 5 6, blue #0039A6 codes A C E, orange #FF6319 codes B D F M with dark text, yellow #FCCC0A codes N Q R W with dark text, purple #9B2A92 code 7, lime #6CBE45 code G with dark text). Status colors: go #10b981 (correct, at or above the 70% pass line), stop #ef4444 (wrong, below 70%), caution #f59e0b (flagged), statute indigo #818cf8 only for legal citations. Radius 24 for hero sheets, 18 for cards, 14 for controls, full pills for chips and bullets. 16px gutters, 20px between sections. Elevation by surface lightness, no drop shadows except the floating tab bar. Numbers tabular, Helvetica Neue bold. Do NOT use all-caps eyebrow labels, middle-dot separated meta strings, or arrows inside buttons. Avoid a stack of identical cards: vary density and grouping.

Screen: Performance (the Stats tab). Shows where the student is weak across all quizzes so far.
Header: compact large title "Performance" (28px) with a one-line subtitle like "412 answers across 9 quizzes".
Section 1, the signature element: a "system map" of all 19 syllabus topics, styled like a subway service status board. A 3-column grid of compact tiles; each tile has the route bullet, a short topic name (License law, Agency, Fair housing, Finance, Valuation, Math, Condos and co-ops, Title and deeds, Land use, Estates and liens, Municipal, Contracts, Construction, Rentals, Insurance, Taxes, Closing, Commercial, Property mgmt) and the accuracy in large tabular numerals. Tile states: at or above 70% shows the percent in go green with a small green status dot; below 70% is weak: percent in stop red and a 1px red outline; untested tiles are dimmed with a long dash instead of a number. A one-line legend under the grid: green dot "70% and up", red dot "Weak, under 70%", hollow dot "Not tested".
Below the map, a full-width 56px primary button "Retest weak areas" with a trailing count pill "5 topics".
Section 2 "Accuracy by topic", sorted weakest first: rows with route bullet, topic name, right-aligned "correct/answered", and a 6px bar with a small vertical tick marking the 70% pass line; red fill below the line, green above. Untested topics at the end, dimmed.
Section 3 "Quiz log": a grouped list of past quizzes, newest first, hairline dividers between rows, each whole row tappable with a subtle chevron: left a PASS (green) or FAIL (red) pill, then the quiz title ("Mock exam", "Weak areas retest", "Quick drill") with a secondary line holding the date, mode and "54/75", and a large right-aligned score percent.
Bottom: floating glass capsule tab bar inset 12px from the screen edges, blurred translucent surface, 5 icon+label tabs: Home, Build, Stats (active, marked with a small go-green pill), Mistakes, More.
